faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about PixBanana
faq.q1: What is PixBanana and how does it work?
faq.a1: PixBanana is an advanced AI-powered image generation platform that creates stunning visuals from text descriptions. Simply describe what you want to create, choose your preferred style and model, and our AI will generate unique, high-quality images in seconds.
faq.q2: What's the difference between Text-to-Image and Image-to-Image?
faq.a2: Text-to-Image generates entirely new images from your text descriptions. Image-to-Image allows you to upload an existing image and transform it using AI while maintaining the original composition. Both modes support multiple styles and models.
faq.a3: We currently offer two powerful models: PixBanana V2, optimized for creative and artistic styles with excellent character consistency, and Flux, which excels at photorealistic renders and complex scenes. More models are coming soon!
faq.q4: How many images can I generate?
faq.a4: Free tier users can generate up to 50 images per day. Pro users enjoy unlimited generations. We also offer flexible credit packages for occasional users who need more than the free tier provides.
faq.a5: We offer a wide range of styles including Default (balanced), Anime (Japanese animation style), Realistic (photorealistic), Fantasy, Cyberpunk, Watercolor, 3D Render, and many more. You can also mix styles for unique results.
faq.q6: Can I use generated images commercially?
faq.a6: Yes! All images generated with PixBanana are yours to use for personal or commercial projects. This includes social media, marketing materials, products, and more. Pro subscribers get enhanced license protection.
faq.q7: How do I maintain character consistency across multiple images?
faq.a7: PixBanana V2 features advanced character consistency technology. Simply reference your character's name or describe them consistently across prompts. For best results, use our character reference feature in Image-to-Image mode.
faq.q8: What resolution and format are the images?
faq.a8: Images are generated in high resolution (up to 2048x2048) and provided in PNG format with support for transparency where applicable. Pro users can access even higher resolutions and additional formats.
faq.q9: Is there an API for developers?
faq.a9: Yes! We offer a comprehensive REST API for developers to integrate PixBanana into their applications and workflows. API access is available for Pro and Enterprise plans with detailed documentation.
faq.q10: How do I write better prompts?
faq.a10: Be specific and descriptive! Include details about subject, style, mood, lighting, composition, and colors. For example: 'A cute cat sitting on a windowsill, sunset lighting, watercolor style, warm colors' works better than just 'cat'.
faq.q11: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a11: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Ethereum). All payments are processed securely through our PCI-compliant payment partners.
faq.q12: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a12: Absolutely! You can cancel your subscription at any time with no questions asked. You'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period. We also offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for new subscribers.
